brief:
Palestinian-led parties that won a record number of parliament seats are facing an intimidation campaign, Al Jazeera English reported. The parties' electoral success has prompted a backlash against Palestinian citizens of Israel who supported them.

Details of the specific intimidation tactics and responses from the parties were not immediately available. The election result gave Palestinian-led parties their largest representation in Israel's parliament to date.
dek: After winning a record number of parliament seats, Palestinian-led parties face campaign against them.
title: Palestinian parties face intimidation after record Israeli election gains
